intent: Teach hourly recording without invented data; metal artwork versus scrap; local musician helping tune guitar; quiet practice before show; one actor with two distinct roles; warmup before stage; questions about her new novel without all; reading beside river without inferring recitation.
picturePurpose: Four individually authored code scenes, one past warmup order, two exact evidence subsets and one original metal-bird sculpture/material picture. Original and derivative actually opened; phone geometry and all app checks pending.

三条新信息
园丁每小时记录一次温度。导游在讲解前轻声练习。一位年轻访客在池塘边阅读。
词语提示：gardener 园丁；talk 讲解；visitor 访客；pond 池塘。

options.text: The gardener recorded the temperature every day. The guide practised quietly before the talk. A young visitor read beside the pond.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对记录间隔、练习声音与先后、阅读位置；不凭人物身份补活动。

steps.text: 每小时记录一次：recorded the temperature every hour。
steps.reason: every hour不是every day；原句没有具体温度值。

steps.text: 讲解前轻声练习：practised quietly before the talk。
steps.reason: quietly与before都要保留；after把顺序改反。

steps.text: 年轻访客在池塘边阅读：A young visitor read beside the pond。
steps.reason: beside是旁边，不是in里面；read没有明确说出声朗诵。

distractors.reason: every day把每小时的间隔改成每天。

explanation.pitfall: every后的单位、before的顺序、beside的位置都影响句意；人物身份不能替代原文证据。
